title: Amplitude, frequency and phase

visualBrief.description: Draw two labelled time traces with equal frequency and different amplitudes; a third trace has a phase shift. Show 10 ms period for 100 Hz.
visualBrief.alt: Amplitude, frequency and phase; Peak size: amplitude. Cycles per second: frequency. Relative timing: phase. Convert Hz using 2*pi*f.

from.label: MathWorks: analog passband modulation; reference for the modulation families

walkthrough.say: A sinusoid is x(t)=A sin(2*pi*f*t+phi): A is amplitude, f is frequency in Hz and phi is phase in radians.
Set a 100 Hz message source using Frequency = 2*pi*100 rad/s; inspect one cycle lasting 10 ms.
Peak size: amplitude. Cycles per second: frequency. Relative timing: phase. Convert Hz using 2*pi*f.
